title: ESP32 built-in RGB LED: check the board first

spans.text: Many ESP32 boards have no built-in RGB LED. Where present, the LED may be addressable or a discrete RGB part with different pin/driver wiring. `RGB_BUILTIN` and `rgbLedWrite` require a supporting Arduino-ESP32 version and board.

spans.caption: ESP32 built-in RGB LED: check the board first

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: A compile error often means the board selection or core version does not provide this API. Check the board schematic; do not guess an LED GPIO.

visual_description: Add a wiring schematic and pin map showing board pins, VCC/GND, and signal direction; include a memory or task-state diagram where relevant.
